body_en:
Planned for next month is a nice screen designer with a vast bank of UDG's built in - you just use it like a wordprocessor only it builds up a picture as you type! It includes a UDG designer as well so there's no limit to its abilities! There will also be a demo of a solution of the famous TOWERS OF HANOI; more 128K music; a number-analysing program; a new crossword and a simple, single line renumber routine for those uneditable CODE REMs!

There's a special machine code "clear screen" routine; well it's two routines actually; a terrific full-length role-playing game: "THE VALLEY OF ADVENTURE" and all the regulars of course like OUTCLASS, masses of readers' letters ("how do YOU know?", I hear you cry. Well, how do I know that the sun will come up again tomorrow?) more clip art and oh yes, a neat routine that displays user-variable messages-while you load from tape!

Anything else I shall squash in ADD-ENDERS as usual.

Brian.
